paragraphs: Rav Ika, son of Rabbi Chanina, and Rav Ashi, Chullin 90, end of b. (See Ukva bar Chinena.) Bar Chinena, Eruvin 100b; Pesachim 83b; bar Chananya, Shabbat 39b [printed locator ל״ע ב׳]. It requires examination: if he is Rabbi Chanina bar Ika’s son, this Rav Ashi is the later one; if Rabbi Chananya bar Ika is his son, it is the early Rav Ashi.
